# Zudo Works

Zudo Works is an AI-focused Zoho Authorized Partner and IT Solutions Provider specializing in custom software development, Zoho ecosystem implementation, API integrations, and digital transformation.

## Core Navigation
- [Services](services.html) - Custom software engineering, Zoho partner services, system integrations, and business digital transformation.
- [Zoho Partner](zoho-partner.html) - Zoho CRM implementation, Zoho Books customization, custom Creator apps, migration, automation, and ongoing support.
- [Integrations](integrations.html) - Deluge script middleware, Zoho Flow, and custom API connections between CRM/Books and third-party tools.
- [Solutions](solutions.html) - Solution templates organized by operational challenges (CRM, Billing, Sales, Support, HR, Inventory, custom portals).
- [Portfolio](portfolio.html) - Interactive filterable case studies of CRM transformations, finance automation, and custom solutions.
- [Blog](blog.html) - Technical implementation guides, integration best practices, and operations automation insights.
- [Free Guide: The Website Lead System](guide.html) - 5-step conversion optimization framework and audit checklist to turn brochure websites into active customer engines.
- [Company Details](company.html) - Our methodology, core team expertise, target industries, and career openings.
- [Contact](contact.html) - Discovery booking form, physical office location, and business contact coordinates.

## Key Services
1. **Custom Software Development**: Enterprise web applications, APIs, SaaS architectures, database tuning.
2. **Zoho Implementation & Customization**: Zoho CRM blueprints, Zoho Books billing, Creator custom apps, Deluge coding.
3. **API & System Integration**: Middlewares, Zoho Flow, webhooks, connecting payment systems, ERPs, and marketing tools.
4. **Operations Automation**: End-to-end workflow triggers, cross-app data synchronization, report automation.
